result: What I would most wish for is to cultivate a deeper sense of empathy in every individual. If everyone could more intuitively see and feel the experiences of others—a richer empathy toward people we interact with daily and those far removed from our own lives—it could foster more compassion-oriented decisions in everything from family relationships to policy-making. When empathy spaces out from a purely individual concern and becomes an everyday operating principle, it can help reduce suffering and inequality. That shift in perspective would underlie so many positive changes: more equitable systems, stronger support networks, and a broader willingness to help one another.
